target_customer: IT and finance teams at companies that need to track SaaS spend and usage
problem: Companies lose track of the software employees use, which drives wasted spend, slow onboarding and offboarding and security gaps.
product_category: SaaS management and IT operations automation

founders.name: Tyler Diaz
founders.background_notes: YC page describes him as a builder of tech; no further bio found.

founders.name: Chris Curran
founders.background_notes: Later joined LeaseQuery as a sales director per its press release.

technical_complexity.rationale: Discovering SaaS apps through integrations and workflow automation is standard engineering with many connector chores.

defensibility.rationale: Integration depth gives mild lock in, but SaaS management was crowded and features were copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: A finance software company, LeaseQuery, bought it in August 2023 to add SaaS spend management.

market_need_then: Rising SaaS sprawl and per employee tool counts created demand for visibility; sources found do not give spend figures.

branding.domain_note: stackshine.com now redirects to a domain marketplace page (atom.com), so the domain was lost or sold after the acquisition.

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand beyond acquisition notices; the product was folded into LeaseQuery.

outcome_analysis: Stackshine entered YC in Winter 2022 as mission control for enterprise IT and was acquired in August 2023 by LeaseQuery, which wanted a SaaS spend management product, with terms undisclosed. Little is public about traction or funding, so the story is a small team exit about 18 months after the batch rather than a documented venture result.
notes: CB Insights lists 500K total raised (investors Y Combinator, Rebel Fund); this is single source and unverified, so no round is recorded. PitchBook names FinQuery as acquirer, which is the later name of LeaseQuery. Hypepotamus date was ambiguous but CPA Practice Advisor dates the announcement 2023-08-14. Website redirects to a domain marketplace. No dated SaaS management competitor sources from 2022 were found, so competitors are left empty.
